notes.title: - Dino Run 2 Progress Update -
notes.content:
Hello All,
[p align="start"]Time for another update regarding our progress on Dino Run 2!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/16340a75fdcc63409c902a52a10b5f4190094efc.png"]
Kickstarter Campaign[p align="start"]Things are rolling along well, and we've reached four of our funding goals so far. If you want to throw it some support, Click here to check it out. Next funding goal will unlock the Jungle Homestead, which adds a new biome and placeable objects to your domestic endeavors in the Dino Run universe:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/77fe35b9fb49ca9a525ff86013349858309fcf3d.png"]Multiplayer Sandbox[p align="start"]We're weeks away from launching Pivots, which will allow you to pin any object to the world and rotate around it. All backers of the Kickstarter campaign get immediate access to the sandbox. With pivots you can start to make your prehistoric engineering ideas come to life:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/e51365e241fa5fc03758ed1eaa005922b59e07d6.gif"]
What's Next
Level Generator: Define parameters and "roll" a level until you like the way it looks, then enter it and start adding on objects and decorations.

Doomwall 1.0: a basic version of the doom to add the necessary urgency that Dino Runners demand...
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Many more of our future tasks can be seen on the ROADMAP in the kickstarter campaign. We're going to keep on with it until it's ready to launch into Early Access in 2026. Thanks again for the patience and support!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]-Miles @ Pixeljam

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/1d767de6726e7a617b7c68b76154f13781d1a1d2.png"]

notes.title: Sandbox Mega-Update!
notes.content:
Hello all,

We recently made a major update to the Sandbox Alpha, available to all current supporters:

Raptor:

 Added tail whap ability 
 Improved raptor collisions
 Added several new idle animations
 Raptor's feet now adapt to terrain while idle
 Raptor now blinks procedurally
 Added crouching
 Added pounce animation
 Added vanity station for changing the raptor's color palette and patterns


Sandbox:

 Added several new placeable objects
 Added several decorative placeables (Ferns, trees, etc.)
 Added a flavor selector for placeables (bouncy, icy, etc)
 Added palette swapping and flavor variations to almost all placeable objects


Misc:

 Expanded the start cave into a new sanctuary
 Added a debug console
 Dragonflies now come in several colors
 Supporters list is updated automatically


Check the video for what this actually looks like: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXM-fPwW228

We're steadily working towards bringing this (and much more) over to Early Access sometime in 2025.

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: A Wild Dino Run 2 Spotted On Steam! Read This And Get Ready...
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/7b5f608cd96e3f2595d6bec0c1e01f49eb546425.png

Dino Run 2 has been a long time coming.

We dreamt it up over 10 years ago, ran an over-ambitious kickstarter for it in 2013 (which did not reach its goal), and followed it up with a very realistic campaign in 2019, which saw enough success to get us tinkering with the game's basic systems from 2019 to 2022.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/ce64cbc667eb4e2734d3ad8a84add3bf1b2a6425.png

Development was rocky during that time though, to put it mildly. Mid-2022 we pushed the RESET button and started from scratch.  With the help of some new team members, the success of Nova Drift and the ongoing crowdfunding campaign, we have arrived where we are now, the SANDBOX ALPHA, which is totally playable and a solid foundation to the larger Dino Run 2 experience:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/9395ce1ff2fdfaeacf30f93eca09a2a129238348.gif

However, it's not ready for Steam yet.  We'll be updating the current playable over the next year or so getting it *just* right for its big debut.

In the meantime, If you want to check out the current playable build, head on over to that campaign link above :)

Here's to a great (prehistoric) future!

-Miles @ Pixeljam
